title: Premium smartphone prices may rise over 30% by year-end: Counterpoint
description:
Prices of premium flagship smartphones are expected to go up by 30 per cent to over Rs 1 lakh apiece across most of the brands by end of the year due to a sharp rise in memory chip cost, market research firm Counterpoint said on Friday.
Along with the increase in prices of the devices, consumer expectations are also rising, and consumers are looking for meaningful specifications that can match the desired experience across processing speed of the mobile phones, camera, battery, durability, after-sales service, etc.
"A few years ago, a Rs 1-lakh smartphone was a rarity in India. Today, as flagship prices keep rising, this price point is becoming increasingly common. Prices of premium flagship devices are expected to rise by more than 30 per cent by the end of 2026 compared with 2025," Counterpoint Research said in a report.
